title: URP not HDRP
rationale: User: 'Unity cok kasiyor'. HDRP would make it worse. URP + good lighting/post hits realistic enough at 60fps on weak GPU.

title: Hand-built valley before procedural
summary: Vertical slice is one hand-crafted valley; procedural generation is post-slice.
rationale: Procedural first = unshippable scope. Prove the loop by hand.

title: Forgiving combat
summary: Dodge window generous, night wave beatable first try with care.
rationale: It's a 2h kafa-dagitma game, not a soulslike. Remnant feel, not Remnant difficulty.

title: Bounded fog rule
summary: Fog linear 15-70m, never exp^2 high density.
rationale: Root-caused the blank-teal-void: unbounded fog ate the frame.
